title: 第1875章 拿到编制第1874章 太白镇土
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
镇土星主说谢，谢的是楚少野杀了太阴星主，太阴星主是他的杀父仇人，以他的实力想自己报仇很难。
即便楚少野杀太阴星主不是为了帮他报杀父之仇，但从结果来看确实应该谢。
楚少野抬手虚扶他起身，“不必如此。”
不管怎么说他也拿到神纹了，镇土星主那道土属性神纹早就给金线寻宝鼠吸收了。
镇土星主起身，请他进入星主府中。
镇土星主和欧阳通一样也准备也很多，明显很是重视，除了口头上道谢，他还交给了楚少野一件储物灵器，里面装的都是谢礼。
镇土星和太白星一样，同样以灵矿资源为主，只是灵矿的种类不同，储物灵器中放的大都是高阶灵矿。
楚少野看了一眼储物灵器内的东西，感觉他很会来事，虽然镇土星现在也不同以往，但肯定不至于没落，如果这位新任镇土星主以后也能得到神纹，那镇土星还能再发展起来。
镇土星主这么做也不全是为了答谢他的恩情，也为了跟他搞好关系，如果能跟楚少野搞好关系，那就算镇土星现在还没有大星主坐镇也算有个依仗。
感觉这位新任镇土星主挺靠谱，楚少野就跟他说了打算在紫衡星上建立炼器学院，培养炼器师的事。
要培养炼器师，灵矿用的肯定不少。
镇土星主眼睛一亮，当即就想合作，其实不止白沙星，像太白星和镇土星这样以灵矿资源为主的星球炼器术发展的都不错，只是镇土星上也没有炼器学院这样的东西。
两人商讨了一番，墨宏和叶南坐在下首听着，很是羡慕，要是他们阵法师也能有这样的学院就好了。
等宴席结束，镇土星主带三人去了传送法阵所在的地方，”先前我父亲和太阴战斗，波及到了传送法阵，我已经请阵法师来修复了。“
只是法阵虽修好了，但却不能使用，这事他早就跟太阳星主禀报过。
镇土星主对墨宏道：“还要麻烦大师。”
墨宏受宠若惊，再怎么说镇土星主也是四星星主，他哪里当得上麻烦。
有活儿干就不错了。
“大人客气了。”
墨宏和叶南立刻着手修改传送法阵，镇土星上的传送法阵刚被修复好不久，不过负责修复的阵法师手艺不怎么精湛，修复后的传送法阵比之前还累赘，以后再用花费更多。

不过现在已经不是问题了，按照金线寻宝鼠修改后的图纸将召唤法阵再修改过来就是。
因为这次要修改的比较多，花费的时间也长一些，镇土星主带楚少野参观了一下镇土星，关键是资源星上的各种灵矿。
金线寻宝鼠没有再留下，而是跟楚少野一起，到这些资源星上的时候哈喇子差点流出来。
它现在是镇星境星兽，寻常宝物已经入不了它的眼，但镇土星的这些资源星不一样，存在都极其久远，矿脉深处的高品阶灵矿数不胜数，甚至还有不少矿母。
content_en:
Lord Zhentu said thank you, but he was grateful to Chu Shaoye for killing the Lord of Taiyin. Lord of Taiyin was his father-killing enemy, and it would be difficult for him to avenge himself with his strength.
Even if Chu Shaoye didn't kill the Taiyin Star Master to help him avenge his father's murder, judging from the result, he should be thanked.
Chu Shaoye raised his hand to help him stand up, "It doesn't have to be like this."
In any case, he also got the divine mark. The earth-attribute divine mark of the Lord of Saturn had long been absorbed by the Golden Thread Treasure Hunter Rat.
Lord Zhentu stood up and invited him into the Star Lord's mansion.
Lord Zhentu, like Ouyang Tong, also made a lot of preparations and obviously took it very seriously. In addition to verbally thanking him, he also gave Chu Shaoye a spiritual storage device, which was filled with thank-you gifts.
Zhentuo Planet, like Taibai Star, also mainly uses spiritual mineral resources, but the types of spiritual minerals are different. Most of the spiritual minerals stored in the storage spiritual weapons are high-level spiritual minerals.
Chu Shaoye took a look at the contents of the spiritual storage device and felt that he was very capable of doing things. Although Suppressing Saturn is different now, it will definitely not decline. If the new master of Suppressing Saturn can also obtain the divine mark in the future, then Suppressing Saturn can develop again.
The Lord of Suppressing Saturn did this not only to repay his kindness, but also to establish a good relationship with him. If he could establish a good relationship with Chu Shaoye, then he would have someone to rely on even if Suppressing Saturn did not have a big star lord in charge yet.
Feeling that the new Saturn-suppressing Lord was quite reliable, Chu Shaoye told him about his plan to establish an Weapon Refining Academy on Ziheng Planet to train Weapon Refiners.
To train a weapon refiner, a lot of spiritual minerals must be used.
The Lord of Saturn's Suppressing Star's eyes lit up, and he immediately wanted to cooperate. In fact, not only Baisha Planet, but planets such as Taibai Star and Suppressing Saturn, which mainly rely on spiritual mineral resources, have developed good weapon refining techniques. However, there is no such thing as a refining academy on Suppressing Saturn.
The two discussed it for a while, and Mo Hong and Ye Nan sat down and listened, feeling very envious. It would be great if their formation masters could also have such an academy.
After the banquet was over, the Lord of Saturn took the three people to the place where the teleportation circle was located. "My father fought with Taiyin earlier, which affected the teleportation circle. I have asked the formation master to repair it."
It's just that although the magic circle has been repaired, it cannot be used. He has already reported this to the Sun Star Lord.
Lord Suppressing Saturn said to Mo Hong: "I still need to trouble the master."
Mo Hong was flattered. No matter how much he said that the Lord of Saturn was also the Lord of Four Stars, how could he be in trouble?
It would be nice to have some work to do.
"My lord, you're welcome."
Mo Hong and Ye Nan immediately started to modify the teleportation array. The teleportation array on Zhentuo had just been repaired not long ago, but the formation master responsible for the repair was not very skilled. The repaired teleportation array was more cumbersome than before, and it would cost more to use again in the future.
But it's no longer a problem now. Just modify the summoning circle according to the modified drawings of the Golden Thread Treasure Hunting Rat.
Because there were more modifications to be made this time and it took a longer time, the Lord of Saturn took Chu Shaoye to visit the planet. The key was the various spiritual mines on the resource planet.
The Golden Thread Treasure Hunting Rat did not stay anymore, but went with Chu Shaoye. When they arrived on these resource stars, the rabbit almost leaked out.
It is now a Star-Suppressing Realm star beast, and ordinary treasures can no longer enter its eyes. However, these resource stars of Saturn-Suppressing Planet are different. They have existed for an extremely long time. There are countless high-grade spiritual minerals deep in the veins, and there are even many mineral mothers.
